data.one_liner: Decode EXIF metadata from TIFF, JPEG, HEIC, PNG and WebP files in Dart.
data.what_it_does: The package reads binary image data and extracts EXIF tags into a map. It supports multiple image formats and works on all major platforms. It provides helper functions to read from bytes or files.
use_when: You need to read camera or image metadata in a pure‑Dart app
You want a lightweight, platform‑agnostic solution without native plugins
avoid_when: You need full image manipulation (resize, crop, etc.)
You require real‑time streaming of EXIF data
strengths: Supports many image formats including WebP and HEIC
Pure Dart, works on mobile, desktop and web
No native code or permissions required
weaknesses: Only extracts metadata, no image processing features
API is relatively low‑level, manual map handling

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides both image manipulation and EXIF extraction in one package
